[DRAFT] Hey McQueen, stop zooming so fast or you'll turn into a blur of math!
If your speed is $v$ and the road is $d$, remember that $t = \frac{d}{v}$, but please don't make $t$ equal to zero!
Also, your red paint job has a surface area $A$, but if you crash, the energy $E = \frac{1}{2}mv^2$ will be all over the place, which is bad for your shiny exterior.
Let's keep the velocity vector $\vec{v}$ pointing forward and not sideways into a fence!
P.P.S. If you see a banana peel on the track, treat it as a friction coefficient $\mu$ that might cause a slip, so please avoid it like a negative number!
